body.p: Go to the platform main page and look for the Log in option, that will display a log in form. Follow the steps to complete the log in process.
A number of authentication options may be available, depending on how your administrator has configured the server, including username and password, and logging with Google or GitHub.
body.note: When you log in with Google or GitHub, reads only your name and email address from the social account. No other data is collected.
